title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Candace Bertotti's passion is to deliver relevant and valuable skills, and enable participants to rapidly put those skills into practice and achieve better results. Candace works with a range of audiences (from CEOs to coal miners), industries (from healthcare to high-tech), and organizations (from Google to Homeland Security and hundreds of others).
